newsitem.title: UK: Zinc steams ahead, trades at $1,600 a tonne.
newsitem.headline: Zinc steams ahead, trades at $1,600 a tonne.

text.p: Three months delivery zinc moved to its highest level since July 1990 to trade at $1,600 a tonne in early brisk business on Friday.
Traders said strong fundamentals were helping to drive the market higher with the premium of cash over three months over cash holding around a $55 backwardation, against $40 on Thursday.
The market continued to digest reports from China that smelters were heavily short. A LME stock fall of 3,450 tonnes to 400,300 helped to bolster upside sentiment.
On Thursday three months zinc ended the London Metal Exchange (LME) afternoon kerb at $1,571.
